# Pro Vehicle Inspections

> Independent mobile pre-purchase car inspections and EV and plug-in hybrid battery health checks. We travel to the car wherever it is for sale across Greater London, Essex, Hertfordshire, Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire, Suffolk, Norfolk, Northamptonshire, Leicestershire, Rutland, Nottinghamshire, South Lincolnshire, the West Midlands and Warwickshire, including Birmingham and Coventry. Prices are the same everywhere in that area, with no call-out or mileage charge.

Pro Vehicle Inspections is run by Henry. Open Monday to Friday 08:00 to 18:00, Saturday and Sunday 10:00 to 16:00. Phone and WhatsApp: 01992 245660. Written enquiries: the contact form at https://www.provehicleinspections.com/contact. Website: https://www.provehicleinspections.com

## Services

- [Vehicle inspections](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/): Standard (£199.99, 160-point) and Premium (£249.99, 260-point) pre-purchase inspections with diagnostics, road test, history check, video review, photo evidence, same-day report and personal buying guidance.
- [What we inspect](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/what-we-inspect): the full 260-point Premium checklist.
- [EV and hybrid battery health check](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/ev-battery-health-check): CARA Approved Autel State of Health report for compatible electric and plug-in hybrid cars, £99.99 on its own or £49.99 with an inspection.
- [Book an inspection](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/book): choose a package, pick a time and pay securely online.

## Areas

One page per area, each saying where buyers there get their cars and how we inspect them. The price is the same everywhere we cover.

- [Vehicle inspection London](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-london): all of Greater London; car supermarkets, the North Circular and A13 dealers, ULEZ checks
- [Pre-purchase car inspection Essex](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/pre-purchase-car-inspection-essex): our home county; the A127 and A13 dealer strips, Chelmsford, Colchester and Southend
- [Luton and Dunstable](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-luton): Tenby Car Supermarket, the Dunstable Road dealers and Dunstable
- [Cambridge](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-cambridge): Marshall on Newmarket Road, Vindis on Milton Road and the city-centre bollards
- [Peterborough](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-peterborough): Motorpoint, Big Motoring World and the Fengate dealers, City Auction Group
- [Leicester](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-leicester): Welford Road, Narborough Road, Melton Road and Sytner at Meridian
- [Nottingham](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-nottingham): the Lenton Lane dealer estate, Arnold Clark and BCA Nottingham
- [Birmingham](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-birmingham): Motorpoint Lichfield Road, the Stratford Road and Coventry Road strips, BCA Perry Barr and the Clean Air Zone
- [Coventry](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-coventry): Motorpoint off Jimmy Hill Way, Sytner BMW on Holyhead Road, Listers Audi on the Fletchamstead Highway; no Clean Air Zone
- [Northampton](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-northampton): Riverside and Bedford Road dealers, Manheim Northampton at Brackmills
- [Norwich](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-norwich): Motorpoint Turnpike Close, the Cromer Road and Hall Road dealers, Postwick
- [Ipswich](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-ipswich): Ransomes Europark and Norwich Road dealers, Hammond Cars; Motorpoint closed in October 2026
- [Hertfordshire](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-hertfordshire): Cheshunt, Hoddesdon, Hertford, Watford, St Albans and Stevenage
- [Cambridgeshire](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-cambridgeshire): Huntingdon, Ely, St Neots, March and Wisbech
- [Suffolk](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-suffolk): Ipswich, Bury St Edmunds, Lowestoft and the coast
- [Norfolk](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-norfolk): Norwich, King's Lynn, Great Yarmouth and the coast; Sandles, Anglia Car Auctions and EAMA Wymondham
- [South Lincolnshire](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-lincolnshire): Grantham, Stamford, Spalding, Boston and Sleaford
- [Nottinghamshire](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-nottinghamshire): Mansfield, Sutton-in-Ashfield, Newark, Worksop and Retford; Available Car and the Southwell Road West dealers
- [Northamptonshire](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-northamptonshire): Kettering, Corby, Wellingborough, Rushden, Daventry and Towcester; Premier Car Supermarket
- [Leicestershire and Rutland](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-leicestershire): Loughborough, Hinckley, Market Harborough, Melton Mowbray, Oakham and Uppingham; Available Car and BCA Donington Park
- [Bedfordshire](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-bedfordshire): Bedford, Kempston, Luton, Leighton Buzzard, Biggleswade and Sandy; BCA Bedford
- [West Midlands](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-west-midlands): Birmingham, Coventry, Solihull, Wolverhampton, Walsall and Dudley; only Birmingham charges a Clean Air Zone
- [Warwickshire](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/vehicle-inspection-warwickshire): Nuneaton, Rugby, Warwick, Leamington Spa, Kenilworth and Stratford-upon-Avon; Nuneaton Car Sales, Allen Ford Rugby and the Listers dealers in Stratford

## Guides

Used car buying guides written by Henry, each answering one question with sourced figures. Index: https://www.provehicleinspections.com/guides

- [How much does a pre-purchase car inspection cost in the UK?](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/guides/pre-purchase-car-inspection-cost-uk): AA, RAC, ClickMechanic, CarExamer and independent prices as published on 19 October 2026, what the 'from' means, what is left out
- [AA vs RAC vs independent: which car inspection should you book?](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/guides/aa-vs-rac-vs-independent-car-inspection): side-by-side table of price, points, road test, scan, history check, who turns up, turnaround and the cars each refuses
- [Is a pre-purchase car inspection worth it?](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/guides/is-a-pre-purchase-car-inspection-worth-it): the arithmetic, the 2026 data, three real October 2026 cases, when it is most and least worth it
- [What does a pre-purchase car inspection check?](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/guides/what-does-a-pre-purchase-car-inspection-check): mechanical, exterior, interior, the full diagnostic scan, the road test, the history check, what Premium adds, what no inspection can do
- [How do you check an electric car's battery health before you buy?](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/guides/how-to-check-ev-battery-health-before-you-buy): five methods from the dashboard to a full discharge test, normal State of Health by age, red flags, what the £99.99 test reads
- [How long do electric car batteries last?](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/guides/how-long-do-electric-car-batteries-last): Geotab 2026 data (2.3% a year, 81.6% at eight years), replacement rates, what shortens a pack, every major warranty, replacement costs
- [Should you buy a Cat S or Cat N write-off?](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/guides/cat-s-and-cat-n-write-offs): what the categories mean, how often write-offs turn up, what a cheap repair hides, price and insurance, what we check
- [HPI check vs car inspection: do you need both?](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/guides/hpi-check-vs-car-inspection): what a history check covers and cannot see, 2026 prices, which inspection services include one, two real examples
- [Dealer or private seller: which is safer when buying a used car?](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/guides/buying-a-used-car-from-a-dealer-vs-private-seller): Consumer Rights Act 2015 rights, what a private seller owes you, traders posing as private, what to do in each case
- [Buying an imported car: what should you check?](https://www.provehicleinspections.com/guides/imported-cars-what-to-check-before-you-buy): why UK history checks are blind on imports, IVA and registration paperwork, the UK conversion, which services refuse imports, a real £5,000 to £8,500 example
